title: Possible to reference a script template instead of a string ?
body: Possible to reference a script template instead of a string ?

comments.body:
Hey @chrisvidal,

what do you mean by `script template`, you mean a DOM selector referencing a `<script type="text/template">` content?
What about using `document.querySelector('script#template-1').innerHTML` and pass it as the string?

hehe it seems to work nicely :+1: :)
thanks
